name: dify-knowledge
description: Use Dify Knowledge Base Service API from Codex with a bundled skill and CLI helper.

interface.shortDescription: Use Dify knowledge bases from Codex
interface.longDescription: Dify Knowledge bundles a Codex skill and a Python helper for Dify Knowledge Service API workflows: list datasets, create knowledge bases, create text documents, inspect indexing status, upload files, and run retrieval tests without changing Dify source code.
